why: The vote is still misreported. MercoPress says 'all 44 senators present out of 45': 44 were present and all voted for removal. PBS and CT Public both say unanimous. The story, standfirst, key point, timeline, main graphic and both covers (en '44 of 45 senators present', hi '45 में 44 मौजूद सीनेटर') say 44 of the 45 senators present voted to remove him, which still implies one vote against. Separately, the November 9 indefinite strike by a teachers' union of 40,000+ members (in the body, the timeline, the 'upcoming' line and the homepage This Week panel) is in none of the three listed sources (MercoPress, PBS, CT Public).
